english.title: Use a long vehicle on a road with no side marker lamps fitted
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), at a time between

(A)_[sunset and sunrise]_
(B)_[sunrise and sunset when visibility was seriously reduced]_

(C)_[a long vehicle,]_
(D)_[a combination of vehicles,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when the

(E)_[vehicle]_
(F)_[combination of vehicles]_

was not fitted with the obligatory side marker lamps as specified in column 3 of the table to regulation 22 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 22 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level four on the legislative standard scale
